latest_canonical_articles.title: AnBogen Therapeutics: Building a “Starlink” for Cancer Immunotherapy
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Can a small molecule from Taiwan extend the $30 billion PD-1 ecosystem into the 95% of metastatic colorectal cancer patients still beyond immunotherapy’s reach?

latest_canonical_articles.title: 安邦生技：免疫治療的「星鏈計畫」
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 一顆台灣小分子，有機會把三百億美元級PD-1藥王送進九成五患者仍無法受益的治療盲區嗎？

latest_canonical_articles.title: Xtandi 之後，安斯泰來靠誰？從單一明星藥到腫瘤平台的四道驗證門
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Xtandi 仍主導安斯泰來腫瘤收入；Padcev、Vyloy 與下一代 CLDN18.2 資產能否在 LOE 後形成可重複的產品平台，才是下一段考題。

latest_canonical_articles.title: After Xtandi: Can Astellas Build an Oncology Platform?
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Xtandi still dominates Astellas oncology sales. The real test is whether Padcev, Vyloy and the next CLDN18.2 assets can become a repeatable post-LOE platform.

latest_canonical_articles.title: T-cell Exhaustion Across PD-1, CAR-T and TCE: Immunotherapy's Next Contest Is Durability
latest_canonical_articles.summary: PD-1 blockade, CAR-T and T-cell engagers ultimately depend on T cells that can expand, renew and persist. This analysis connects exhaustion biology, product engineering and clinical evidence to the next competitive threshold in immunotherapy.

latest_canonical_articles.title: T 細胞耗竭卡住 PD-1、CAR-T 與 TCE：免疫治療下半場，拼的是誰能撐到最後
latest_canonical_articles.summary: PD-1、CAR-T 與 TCE 最後都仰賴可增殖、可補充且能持久的 T 細胞戰力。本文從耗竭分化、產品工程與臨床資料，拆解免疫治療下半場的真正競爭門檻。

latest_canonical_articles.title: 半年千億，買的是時間
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 2026 上半年生醫併購轉熱，但 BioSpace 的 52 筆與 IQVIA 的 42 筆不能硬拼。真正的主線，是專利懸崖迫使大藥廠用現金購買可計算的臨床時間。

latest_canonical_articles.title: $130 Billion in Six Months: Big Pharma Is Buying Time
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Biopharma M&A accelerated in the first half of 2026, but BioSpace's 52 deals and IQVIA's 42 deals cannot be combined. The deeper story is that patent cliffs are pushing Big Pharma to pay for measurable clinical time.

latest_canonical_articles.title: Can a Pill Take Share from Injectables? The ICOTYDE Commercial Test
latest_canonical_articles.summary: ICOTYDE generated more than 18,000 prescriptions in its first full quarter, showing demand for an oral IL-23R peptide. Valuation now depends on paid scripts, persistence, payer quality, and success beyond psoriasis.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 一顆藥，搶針劑的飯碗
latest_canonical_articles.summary: ICOTYDE 上市首季超過 18,000 張處方，證明口服 IL-23R 胜肽有需求；真正決定估值的，仍是付費處方、續方、支付品質與多適應症兌現。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Roche's Hidden Succession Engine: How 19 New Molecules Could Power the Next Growth Cycle
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Roche generated CHF 47.669 billion in pharmaceutical sales in 2025, with Ocrevus, Hemlibra, and Vabysmo already accounting for roughly one-third of the total. The number that matters is not simply 19 potential new molecules, but whether giredestrant, fenebrutinib, obesity, Alzheimer's, and protein-degradation assets can inherit Roche's existing clinical, diagnostic, and commercial infrastructure on time.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 羅氏的隱藏底牌：19 個新分子排隊接棒，下一個成長週期怎麼長出來？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 羅氏 2025 年製藥銷售 476.69 億瑞士法郎，Ocrevus、Hemlibra 與 Vabysmo 已撐起約三分之一收入。真正值得追的不是 19 個新分子的總數，而是 giredestrant、fenebrutinib、減重、阿茲海默症與蛋白質降解資產能否沿既有臨床、診斷與商業通路準時接棒。

latest_canonical_articles.title: SpaceX Goes to Orbit. Is the Money in the Crystals?
latest_canonical_articles.summary: SpaceX is making low-Earth-orbit round trips more routine, but rockets do not discover drugs. From Keytruda crystallization and SpaceMD to Varda, UK regulation, and a Taiwan mission, this analysis asks whether microgravity-enabled manufacturing can pass the tests of repetition, scale-up, and regulation.

latest_canonical_articles.title: SpaceX 上太空，錢在晶體裡？微重力製藥的第一桶金
latest_canonical_articles.summary: SpaceX 讓低軌往返逐漸有了班次，但火箭不是新藥公司。本文從 Keytruda 結晶、SpaceMD、Varda、英國監管與台灣任務，拆解微重力製藥能否通過重複、放大與監管三道商業考驗。

latest_canonical_articles.title: When a Biotech Says No to a Sale: Five Tests of Whether It Can Become a Biopharma
latest_canonical_articles.summary: An acquisition is not the only successful outcome for a biotech. Using argenx, Insmed, Incyte, and Revolution Medicines as four operating snapshots, this analysis tests product evidence, cash generation, a second growth curve, global execution, and financing options—and shows what retaining control really costs.

latest_canonical_articles.title: Biotech 不賣，憑什麼？五張門票決定它能否長成 Biopharma
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 被收購不是 Biotech 唯一的成功終點。本文以 argenx、Insmed、Incyte 與 Revolution Medicines 為四個截面，檢驗產品證據、現金引擎、第二曲線、全球執行與融資選項，並拆解保留控制權的真實成本。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Madrigal's MASH Platform Strategy: Rezdiffra as the Cornerstone, siRNA as the Next Growth Engine
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Rezdiffra has opened the MASH market and built its commercialization infrastructure. Madrigal is now adding six Ribo siRNA programs and Arrowhead's ARO-PNPLA3 to create a cornerstone-plus-precision-combination treatment matrix.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 聯手巨頭卡位 MASH：Madrigal 把 Rezdiffra 做成基石藥，小核酸開始接棒
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Rezdiffra 已把 MASH 市場與商業化基礎設施打開；Madrigal 再以 Ribo 六條 siRNA 管線與 Arrowhead ARO-PNPLA3，建立基石藥加精準聯用矩陣。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Pelacarsen's HORIZON Test: Does Lowering Lp(a) Prevent Cardiovascular Events?
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Pelacarsen can substantially lower Lp(a), but HORIZON must show whether biomarker reduction on top of standard care translates into fewer cardiovascular deaths, myocardial infarctions, strokes and urgent revascularizations.

latest_canonical_articles.title: HORIZON：Lp(a) 降了，心梗會少嗎？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Pelacarsen 已證明能大幅降低 Lp(a)，但 HORIZON 真正要回答的是：在標準治療之上，生物標記下降能否轉成更少的心血管死亡、心肌梗塞、中風與緊急再血管化。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Animal Studies Are Not Disappearing. Drug Development Rules Are Changing.
latest_canonical_articles.summary: China's CDE PIONEER program opens a regulatory pathway for new approach methodologies. The real test is whether human-relevant evidence becomes reproducible, validated and reusable.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 動物實驗不是消失，而是藥物研發規則開始換代
latest_canonical_articles.summary: CDE 的 NAMs 先鋒計畫為藥企與方法開發者開出雙軌入口；真正的考題是可重複、可驗證且被監管接受的人體相關證據。

latest_canonical_articles.title: When ADCs Enter Autoimmune Disease: Precision Immune Modulation, Not More Killing
latest_canonical_articles.summary: The opportunity for autoimmune ADCs is not to transplant oncology cytotoxins into immune cells. It is to deliver powerful glucocorticoids, small molecules, ASOs or siRNAs selectively to the cells that drive disease. LFD-200 offers an early human proof-of-mechanism signal for that thesis.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 當 ADC 走進自體免疫：不是殺得更狠，而是調得更準
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 自體免疫 ADC 的價值不在把腫瘤細胞毒 payload 搬到免疫細胞，而在把 glucocorticoid、ASO、siRNA 等強效免疫調節作用定向送到真正需要干預的細胞；LFD-200 的早期人體訊號，是這條路第一次重要的機制驗證。
